t: This is the Royal Fusiliers War Memorial in Holborn, a bronze statue standing on a pedestal of Portland stone about five metres high. It honours members of the Royal Fusiliers killed in the World Wars, the Russian Civil War and later conflicts. It also remembers men of several London Regiment battalions who died in the First World War. The statue was made by Albert Toft, an English sculptor, so the figure you see is his work.
